pharmacology.text: JWH-203 (1-pentyl-3-(2-chlorophenylacetyl)indole) is an analgesic chemical from the phenylacetylindole family that acts as a cannabinoid agonist with approximately equal affinity at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors, having a Ki of 8.0 nM at CB1 and 7.0 nM at CB2.

summaryZh: JWH-203，化學名：1-戊基-3-(2-氯苯乙醯基)吲哚，是一種合成大麻素，分子式C21H22ClNO，屬於約翰·威廉·霍夫曼小組合成的苯乙醯基吲哚類JWH系列大麻素，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。
